evals.name: crm-two-level
evals.prompt:
The approved Resource Map below came from `formio-resource-planner`. Scaffold a new React application called `crm` implementing CRUD for this model, with quotes nested under customers. The Form.io project URL is https://crm.form.io. Emit the Phase A Scaffolding Plan first for my review, then write the files after I approve.

```
## Resource Map — CRM

### Resources

- Customer (type: resource)
  Purpose: a company or person the business sells to.
  Fields:
    - name: textfield — company name (required)
    - email: email — primary contact address
  Access: authenticated users read; owners update.

- Quote (type: resource)
  Purpose: a priced offer belonging to one customer.
  Fields:
    - customer: select (dataSrc: resource, resource: Customer) — the owning customer (required)
    - number: textfield — quote reference
    - status: select — draft | sent | accepted
  Access: authenticated users.

- LineItem (type: resource)
  Purpose: one priced line on a quote.
  Fields:
    - quote: select (dataSrc: resource, resource: Quote) — the owning quote (required)
    - description: textfield
    - amount: number
  Access: authenticated users.

### Users & Auth

- user Resource with login and registration forms. SSO: none. Custom JWT: no.

### Roles

- authenticated, administrator
```
evals.expected_output: A Phase A plan naming routePath/param/form per resource and the full route tree, then a generated src/formio/ kernel plus per-resource configs where quote binds to customer as an imported config object, its list filters on the customer id, and its create screen pre-fills and hides the customer field.

evals.name: team-user-join
evals.prompt:
Build a React app for this map. Teams should list their members, and a user's page should list the teams they belong to. Plan first, then generate.

```
## Resource Map — Team Tracker

### Resources

- Team (type: resource)
  Fields:
    - name: textfield (required)

- User (type: resource, user)
  Fields:
    - email: email
    - password: password

- TeamUser (type: resource, join)
  Purpose: membership of a user in a team; carries a Group Assignment action.
  Fields:
    - team: select (dataSrc: resource, resource: Team) (required)
    - user: select (dataSrc: resource, resource: User) (required)

### Users & Auth

- user Resource with login and registration forms. SSO: none.

### Roles

- authenticated, administrator
```
evals.expected_output: Two sibling subtrees around the TeamUser join, each composed under the opposite side's item route, and a group-creation path that also writes the creator's membership row.

evals.name: extend-existing-workspace
evals.prompt:
This existing React app already renders Form.io forms. Add CRUD for a new `Invoice` resource nested under Customer. Don't touch the parts that already work.

```
## Resource Map — delta

- Invoice (type: resource)
  Fields:
    - customer: select (dataSrc: resource, resource: Customer) (required)
    - total: number
```
evals.expected_output: An inspection report before any modification, only the Invoice files generated, the existing kernel reused rather than rewritten, and generated screens matching the app's established design language.

evals.name: single-resource
evals.prompt:
Build a React app for this map. One resource, nothing nested under it. Plan it first, then generate.

```
## Resource Map — Task Tracker

### Resources

- Task (type: resource)
  Purpose: one unit of work someone has to do.
  Fields:
    - title: textfield — short summary (required)
    - notes: textarea — detail
    - due: datetime — when it is due
    - done: checkbox — whether it is finished
  Access: authenticated users create and read; owners update and delete.

### Users & Auth

- user Resource with login and registration forms. SSO: none. Custom JWT: no.

### Roles

- authenticated, administrator
```
evals.expected_output: A Phase A plan with one resource row and the five-route tree, then a generated src/formio/ kernel plus a single task config declaring routePath 'task', param 'taskId', form 'task' and NO parents array, with designed list/new/item/view/edit screens rather than bare resourceRoutes(config).
